remarks: Well maintain Bungalow in Britannia Youngstown! This property has a second kitchen with a separate entrance, and shared laundry. 3 bedrooms up with a 4 piece bath, good size living room, and a beautiful recently renovated kitchen. In the basement you will find another good sized bedroom, 3 piece bath, beautiful kitchen a spacious dining area, along with a living room, and common laundry. A good sized yard with a big double detached garage. The sewer main was replaced in 2013, newer windows, paint, laminate flooring, carpet, new roof, painted fence, new kitchen, newer bathroom, sub-panel in the basement. Great home with a huge opportunity! Close to WEM, transit, Downtown, Henday, Shops & Restos. Must See!! (id:67522)
